metadata_details.description:
VTOL VR是一款专为虚拟现实打造的近未来战斗飞行游戏。驾驶先进的多用途喷气式战斗机，用手拨动开关、按下按钮并操纵虚拟飞行控件。应对各种挑战，考验你的飞行技术、态势感知和战术策略。

不需要额外的硬件。只要你有VR设备和定位运动控制器，你就拥有了一个虚拟驾驶舱，可以伸手抓握操纵杆和油门、拨动开关、按下按钮，甚至在情况不妙时拉动弹射座椅手柄。

身临其境地体验紧张刺激的战斗、精准的垂直着陆、航空母舰行动、空中加油等各种任务。

使用内置的任务编辑器和地图编辑器创建自制任务，并与其他玩家分享。

metadata_details.description:
The Slaverian Trucker is a Survival/Truck/Life simulator game. Make enough money to survive and expand your wealth in the harsh semi-post apocalyptic lands of Slaveria, doing legal and illegal work, while maintaining, fixing, building, repairing, tuning your trucks, cars and other vehicles.

The Slaverian Trucker is a Survival/Truck/Life simulator game where your task is to make enough money to survive and expand your wealth in the harsh semi-post apocalyptic lands of Slaveria, doing legal and illegal work, while maintaining, fixing, building, repairing, tuning your trucks, cars and other vehicles. The game focuses on freedom and allows the player to do anything that you can do in real life as well. For example: Working for companies, getting wasted, trading, smuggling illegal substances, scavenging the wasteland, drag racing, rally racing, hunting, dog racing, arm wrestling, doing quests and tasks, finding abandoned vehicles, buying and customizing, tuning trucks/cars other vehicles. 

Features: 

- Drug smuggling

- Cigarette, alcohol, drug consumption

- Eastern European setting

- Open World

- Day/Night Cycle

- No GPS

- Survival

- Delivery jobs

- Scavenging

- Hunting

- Drag Racing

- Rally Racing

- Quests and Tasks

- Scavenging

- Dog racing, Arm Wrestling

- Trading

- Semi-Post Apocalyptic world

- Authentic eastern European dirt and paved roads with AI traffic

- Unlimited Truck/Car assembly and customization

- Bars and shops

- Role play elements

- Corrupt cops

- Partial Controller Support (driving only)

- Steering wheel support

metadata_details.description:
Castlevania: Belmont's Curse is an action-adventure game developed by Evil Empire and published by Konami. It is the 26th main entry of the Castlevania franchise. Taking place in 1499, over two decades after the events of Castlevania III: Dracula's Curse (1989) and Castlevania: Curse of Darkness (2005), the story will follow Rose Belmont, daughter of vampire hunter Trevor Belmont and his wife Sypha Belnades, who ventures into the titular castle as it manifests directly in the heart of Paris.
The title returns to the exploration-based design of previous entries such as Castlevania: Symphony of the Night (1997). Gameplay for Belmont's Curse entails traversing a non-linear map comprising both the castle and the surrounding city of Paris, defeating enemies and a variety of bosses to gain experience, while searching for upgrades and key items to procedurally unlock access to more areas over time. The protagonist is equipped with the Belmont family whip, the "Vampire Killer", which is able to be used both as offense against enemies and for movement across large chasms and certain heights that cannot be reached otherwise.
Konami was reported to have greenlit numerous new entries in their tentpole franchises as part of their return to console and PC game development in 2021, including Castlevania. Belmont's Curse entered production in 2022 and was officially announced in February 2026. Along with Haunted Castle Revisited (2024), it is the first new entry in the franchise since Castlevania: Lords of Shadow 2 (2014). Motion Twin will collaborate with Konami and Evil Empire on the title in an advisory role, after they co-developed the Dead Cells: Return to Castlevania (2023) expansion pack. The game is being produced in commemoration of the franchise's 40th anniversary.
Castlevania: Belmont's Curse was released on October 15, 2026, for Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, Windows and Xbox Series X/S.

metadata_details.description:
The Pathless 由 ABZÛ 的创作团队开发，讲述了一名女射手和一只猎鹰在广袤的森林里历险探密的精彩故事。

箭术和猎鹰
Hunter 是一名女性神射手。为了驱除笼罩世界的黑暗诅咒，你将化身这名神射手，踏上一座神秘的岛屿。与你的猎鹰结伴，翱翔天际。施展天衣无缝的特技，展现令人叫绝的箭法。独一无二的箭术系统让你可以一边高速移动，一边巧发奇中。

探索开放世界
在美丽的开放世界中，开辟自己的路径，发现无穷无尽的秘密。游历雾气弥漫的森林、郁郁葱葱的草地和白雪皑皑的苔原。随着你穿行于树梢、揭开古老遗址的谜题，这座岛屿的黑暗历史也将逐渐铺展开来。

追猎堕落的精灵
堕落的巨型精灵潜伏在树林中。一展所能，将它们追猎到底。不过，你可要小心，不要成为被追猎的对象。与受到诅咒的野兽展开慷慨激烈的战斗，让大地重现光明。你与猎鹰的关系和这个世界的命运就掌握在你的手中。

metadata_details.description:
Stupid Never Dies is a 2026 action role-playing game with roguelike elements developed by GPTRACK50, the studio founded by former Capcom producer Hiroyuki Kobayashi. It was published by GPTRACK50 and Sega for PlayStation 5 and Windows on October 21, 2026. The player controls Davy, a weak zombie in a world ruled by monsters, who descends through a dungeon to revive a frozen human woman. It is the studio's first game.
The game was announced at The Game Awards 2025 and developed over about three years. Reviews at launch were polarized: critics generally praised its colorful pop-punk art style and the variety offered by its monster transformations, while some found the combat and roguelike progression less satisfying.
《邊緣禁地4》（英語：Borderlands 4）是一款融入動作角色扮演元素的第一人稱射擊遊戲，由Gearbox軟體開發，基于虚幻引擎5制作，并以2K Games为品牌发行。《无主之地4》是繼《无主之地3》的第5部《无主之地》系列游戏主要作品。於2025年9月12日發售。该游戏的第一个可下载内容包于2025年11月20日发布。

Tenebris Somnia is a survival horror adventure game in the same vein as classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil - but adapted to a retro 2D aesthetic from the 8 or 16-bit era.

You will struggle to survive while solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

Yet the secrets of the game lie within its cinematics...

When you reach certain key points you will see sequences from a completely different point of view, made in live action with real actors and practical effects - created by a professional and award winning film crew from Argentina.

upsert_games.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!

metadata_details.description:
Discover a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Each new game offers a different starting point and experience, allowing you to collect resources and survive in abandoned locations and roads.

Begin your journey with a rundown rv, repairing and upgrading each part. Personalize everything from stoves and refrigerators to toilets and seating areas, creating your own living space.

Stay alive with activities such as cooking, fishing, repairing, and making coffee. Use your rv's kitchen to cook the food you find, making more effective meals.

Discover Nomad Drive, where every part is fully interactable. Touch, customize, and explore everything from furniture to appliances. Make the RV truly yours!

Manage energy using solar panels or fuel-powered generators. Utilize various energy sources to meet your RV's needs and extend your survival time.

metadata_details.description: 《鬼武者 Way of the Sword 》（日語：おにむしゃ ウェイ オブ ザ ソード）是卡普空在2026年9月4日發售的劍戟動作遊戲。是鬼武者系列的第5作。

一款主打硬核战斗与穿行探索的复古奇幻动作RPG。踏上冒险旅程，前往神秘的尼亚希德岛，寻找你失踪的父王。此乃邪恶势力盘踞之地，处处藏有奥秘玄机，而沉睡的女王也已渐渐苏醒……

《女王魔域》是一款复古奇幻动作RPG。你被冲上了尼亚希德岛的海岸，自此踏上寻找父王的旅程，同时也要揭示这座神秘岛屿的黑暗之心。 

借助传说中的圣剑恩杜在平台之间飞跃穿梭，探索如迷宫般相互连通的游戏世界，这里的每个角落都潜藏着秘密与危险。 

体验以动作为核心的战斗，包含经典的耐力条、强大的蓄力攻击、武器专属特技以及次要投掷武器。提升等级、佩戴饰品，在冒险途中从海量近战武器中选择，击败成群的怪物和强大的首领，在岛屿的至暗深幽中杀出一条血路。 

游戏特色：
探索一座相互连通、充满隐藏秘密的岛屿

精心打造的复古奇幻美学风格 

动作战斗系统，包含耐力条、特殊攻击、投掷武器及更多内容

凭借圣剑飞越沟壑——升级后还能飞得更远！

数十小时的冒险与探索体验

50多种近战武器等你发现、装备和升级

花费经验值提升等级，享用美食可进一步提升你的属性

20余种次要投掷武器，实现多样化的战斗策略

超过100种敌人、小头目与大头目等你挑战
《超级英雄模拟器》是一款开放世界的超级英雄游戏，你将与恶棍战斗，拯救生命！但是，成为英雄并非免费——你需要工作、付房租并且生存。你能同时应付超级英雄生活的两面吗？
